rows.reason: 007AED10 is a 3D nearest-point search (dx, dy, dz, sqrt) reached through 007B1100 -> 007B0900, which also transforms the position into the path's local frame. The commands host's path build is handed only the unit's x and z (begin_current_command_00835c70 / begin_path_command_0071f600 signatures; GameCommandTargetFacts carries x/z only) and keeps no path-entity transform, so the body would be fed a constant y. Needs the unit y (entity+FCh) and the path world matrix plumbed into GameCommandsHost.

The component min feeds the path's bounding box in 007AF150; the host's derive_camera_path_knots_007af150 (camera_path_sampler.cpp) keeps no bounds (CameraPathKnotTotals has no bbox field) and nothing in the host reads one, so wiring would compute an unused value.
Same as 007AE330: the component max is the bounding box's upper corner in 007AF150, which the host's knot derivation does not keep and no host code reads.

Both callers (007A87B0 MovCam_UpdateHandMode, 007A8C60 MovCam_PickDeckPointScored) reach it only through host.movcam_enter_vehicle_camera_007a6710 in cc13_segmix.cpp / cc13_sweepB2.cpp, Host interfaces no game_host file implements; the movie camera has no host owner.
